title: Accounts invoiced more than their current plan's annual price in 2025
prompt: Find accounts whose total paid invoice amount in 2025 exceeds what their current plan's monthly_price × 12 would suggest — a possible plan mismatch or add-on charges worth investigating.
population: Paid invoices issued in 2025, and each account's subscription active at year-end 2025 (for its plan price).
metricDefinition: 2025 paid invoice total vs. (current plan monthly_price × 12); flagged when the total exceeds that expected annual amount.
transformationPlan: sum 2025 paid invoice amounts per account
join to each account's subscription active at year-end 2025, for its plan's monthly_price
compare the invoice total to monthly_price × 12
keep accounts where the total exceeds that expected amount
referenceSql: WITH invoice_totals AS (SELECT account_id, sum(amount) AS total_2025 FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id), current_plan AS (SELECT s.account_id, p.monthly_price FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31' AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31')) SELECT it.account_id, it.total_2025, cp.monthly_price * 12 AS expected_annual FROM invoice_totals it JOIN current_plan cp ON cp.account_id = it.account_id WHERE it.total_2025 > cp.monthly_price * 12
